forecasts.title: Who Will Win the 2026 World Cup
forecasts.question: Who will win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
forecasts.dek: Six standing predictor profiles each committed to one champion; the council's consensus pick is France at 28–32%, with the Historian's Argentina dissent preserved.

forecasts.title: The Iran War Through 2028
forecasts.question: How does the Iran war resolve — settlement, another round, frozen standoff, regime change, or the bomb?
forecasts.dek: Five priced scenarios for the US–Israel–Iran confrontation: a funded settlement is the favorite at 31–41%, with a third war round overlapping at 27–37% — the six standing profiles split 3–2–1.
